description: Add files to a drop owned by the authenticated account (requires an sp_ API key and an active subscription): up to 900 files per call, 10,000 per drop total, and existing paths are overwritten. The drop keeps its current expiry and password protection.

files.description: Map of relative paths (e.g. 'index.html', 'css/app.css') to either a string, or { encoding: 'base64', content } for binary files.

slug.description: The drop slug (the subdomain part of its ${domain} URL).

name: append_files

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null when the drop never expires

total_files.description: Total files on the drop after the append

title: Append files to an existing drop
